The execution failed due to schema mismatches and significant calculation errors in the financial totals.
The test_legacy_pytest_suite failed with 3 errors in /tests/test_outputs.py. test_template_preservation_and_schema failed because data['analysis']['assumptions'] contained 7 unexpected keys like 'contract_match_fields'. test_rows_and_order failed due to extra keys 'shipper_cost_basis' and 'cadence_financials' in the panel rows. test_totals_and_decision showed a major calculation discrepancy: close(26185.96, 1090.76) returned False.
